rca of the issue: Original bug caused by strict column-name matching in import_preview (only exact 'nisn') and lack of empty-row skip. Fix uses loose text-contains matching with 'nisn' checked BEFORE 'nis' to avoid substring conflict, and silently drops rows where all fields are empty.
